title: Summer Internship
highlights: Exploring a heterogeneous programming model in Scala that allows ordinary programs to span host and GPU execution while preserving a Scala-idiomatic and unified programming abstraction.

Building an extension with additional compiler phases for Scala’s Dotty compiler to lower annotated Scala functions to SPIR-V for GPU execution, and a program that assembles SPIR-V-as-Scala classes into binary form.
Exploring the feasibility of using capture tracking for enclosing host state and external host-device interactions, as well as CPS transformations and trampolining for function calls.
